rows: Your mat wrestling is excellent. Now show me the strength and timing it takes to bring me down.
You can produce a great deal of force. Winning takes more than the first application of it.
I don't need to match your height. I need to meet you when you come back to the ground.
You like to set a slow rhythm. I'm going to make you work at mine.
They've worked for the money they spent here. We should work just as hard to deserve it.
I'm not going to sell myself with a speech. Watch the effort in the ring.
The number beside my name on that card doesn't set the standard. My performance does.
Take a proper look. That is the standard I am asking you to match.
I'll have to work for the takedown. That's precisely why I'm prepared to do it.
Try taking my best strike before you reduce it to a theory.
You'll need to make the catch when I'm already moving. Not an easy lift.
I'm managing the pace. Come and change it if you can.
I'm ready to carry my share of that match. You carry yours.
You can claim the biggest slot. You cannot claim the performance before it happens.
Meeting your {strength} head on is a real test. I'm not going to lower the standard to get round that.
You've made the case for your {strength}. I have to demonstrate that I can meet it.
I'm not questioning your character. I'm competing for a result.
I won't shout at you. I have something to show you in the ring.
Anger isn't going to improve my form. We can settle it properly.
One fall, neat. Nobody else involved. Equal terms.
Meet me on the mat and demonstrate that advantage.
Keep both feet on the canvas and give me an equal test.
Stay between the ropes with me. Finish what you start.
Then we agree on the standard.
You're avoiding the comparison. Give me a straight answer.
That's a fair point. I won't argue with it.
Good. Now we have a contest.
I expect to have to work for every inch. I will prevail.
I will be the winner. That is my standard.
A neat fall, halfway. No shortcuts from either of us.
I've put the preparation in. You'll find out what it was.
I hold my wrestling to a standard. I must hold my words to it too. I cannot establish that charge.
I have no particular incident I can cite with confidence. Equal terms mean leaving that allegation out.
Good. No unproved allegation between us. Meet the standard in the ring.
That's a fair correction. We'll settle the sporting question on equal terms.
They can see whether I keep my form when you make me work for every inch.
Let them judge the effort and the result. I intend to meet the standard without making claims I cannot support.
Leave the accusation aside. What can we demonstrate when we both have to earn every advantage?
The people can judge the work we put in out there. What can we show them about our wrestling?
You've prepared to meet my {strength} head on. Good. I intend to make you earn every inch of that defence.
I respect the work you've put into answering my {strength}. You still have to match the effort when I apply them.
